name: com.classicspins.pf-ads-max
description: An optional PrototypeFramework service module: the framework's IAdsService backed by the AppLovin MAX Unity plugin (interstitial and rewarded), plus the MAX replacement for the AdsInit boot node, in which MAX's own consent flow runs. The MAX SDK is not a dependency here — it is declared in pf-module.json and installed through Framework/Setup Wizard ▸ Modules. Without it the module still compiles and refuses every ad, logging pf-ads-max, instead of falling back to the auto-rewarding fake.
